q: The Halmos–von Neumann theorem classifies ergodic MPTs with discrete spectrum (all eigenvalues countable) by:
opts: Their group of eigenvalues Eig(T) ⊆ S¹
exp: Halmos–von Neumann (1942): discrete spectrum systems (Koopman operator has pure point spectrum spanning L²) are classified by their eigenvalue group Eig(T) ⊆ ℚ/ℤ (or S¹). Irrational rotations R_α and R_β are isomorphic iff α=±β mod ℤ.
